title: Horrible Dank Sour Smell - had to throw out
text: Horrible Dank Sour Smell - had to throw out. Horrible sour overpowering smell. We purchased this in April. We aired outside for a week; smell is still there. We have had to remove from the house as the smell literally overpowered everything. We put in the barn thinking such a large space it may not be noticeable. The Barn reeks - we threw out this morning.
